# Ivan Bakalo — Financial Stability & Governance Expert

> Professional portfolio and National Interest Waiver (NIW) supporting platform for Ivan Bakalo, a financial governance and systemic risk professional based in New York, NY. The site presents research, professional engagement, and evidence of contributions to U.S. financial stability and institutional resilience.

Ivan Bakalo specializes in systemic risk analysis, financial stability frameworks, risk-based audit methodology, and regulatory compliance. His proposed endeavor supports the long-term stability and integrity of the U.S. financial system — an area of substantial merit and national importance under the NIW framework.

## Site Sections

- [Home](https://ivanbakalo.com/#home): Introduction, professional positioning (Financial Stability · Governance · Systemic Risk), and primary calls to action.
- [About](https://ivanbakalo.com/#about): Professional background, expertise in risk-based audit methodology, financial stability frameworks, systemic risk analysis, and regulatory compliance. Member of The Institute of Internal Auditors, New York, NY.
- [Research](https://ivanbakalo.com/#research): Academic and professional articles across four categories — U.S. Banking System, Financial Stability, Risk & Regulation, Research & Methodology — with a featured article block and category filter tabs.
- [Implementation & Recognition](https://ivanbakalo.com/#implementation): Evidence of professional impact across five categories — Recognition, Professional Development, Certifications, Implementation, Academic Participation.
- [Professional Engagement](https://ivanbakalo.com/#engagement): Active participation in governance, AI risk, and financial stability ecosystems across five categories — AI Governance, Audit & Cybersecurity, Governance Discussions, Continuing Education, Memberships.
- [Proposed Endeavor](https://ivanbakalo.com/#endeavor): NIW petition summary. Four pillars: (1) Risk-based governance frameworks for financial institutions; (2) Systemic risk analysis and financial stability research; (3) Regulatory compliance architecture and U.S. standards alignment; (4) Institutional resilience and internal control enhancement.
- [Research Profiles](https://ivanbakalo.com/#profiles): Academic and professional presence on SSRN, Google Scholar, ORCID, ResearchGate, and LinkedIn with live citation and impact metrics.
- [Contact](https://ivanbakalo.com/#contact): Email bakalo.science@gmail.com · LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/ivanbakalo · Location New York, NY.

## API Endpoints (JSON, public)

- [Profile Stats](https://ivanbakalo.com/api/profile-stats): Citation and impact metrics — Google Scholar (citations all-time, since 2021, h-index, i10-index), SSRN (total downloads, papers count), ORCID (works count, auto-refreshed daily), ResearchGate (publications, reads, citations).
- [Articles](https://ivanbakalo.com/api/articles): Research articles with title, category, description, year, tags, SSRN URL, DOI URL, and featured flag.
- [Evidence](https://ivanbakalo.com/api/evidence): Implementation and recognition entries with title, category, institution, year, and evidence URL.
- [Engagements](https://ivanbakalo.com/api/engagements): Professional engagement entries with title, category, organization, year, and evidence URL.
